summary_en: J Trust Co., Ltd. agreed to tender all of its shares in HYBE Co., Ltd. (listed on Korea Exchange) to a public tender offer by HYBE JAPAN at 1 yen per share, with total consideration of 1.9 billion yen. Upon completion, HYBE will cease to be an equity-method affiliate of J Trust.
title_en: Notice Regarding Subscription to Public Tender Offer and Changes in Equity-Method Affiliate
translation_en_brief:
J Trust Co., Ltd. resolved on the stated date to tender all shares it holds in HYBE Co., Ltd. (a South Korean entertainment company listed on the Korea Exchange) to a public tender offer (OTC) being conducted by HYBE JAPAN, a wholly owned subsidiary of HYBE Co., Ltd. The public tender offer price is set at 1 yen per ordinary share, with total proceeds of 1.9 billion yen expected from the sale.

Upon successful completion of the public tender offer, HYBE will cease to qualify as an equity-method affiliate of J Trust. The company determined that this subscription to the tender offer is rational from the perspective of utilizing both groups' management resources and business platforms through the construction of a medium-to-long-term stable capital relationship between HYBE Group and J Trust Group, which is expected to promote business expansion and enhance corporate value. The tender offer price of 1 yen per share represents a reasonable opportunity for J Trust to dispose of its shareholding with consideration of the number of shares held.
